result.justification: The study has a clear objective to investigate the evolution and annealing of hydrogen-bridge defects, and the methodology provides detailed first-principles calculations.

evidence.quote: This work employs first-principles density functional theory to investigate the evolution and annealing of hydrogen-bridge defects.
In this work, first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT) were performed using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP).
